episode.title: MTG Fast Finance Ep 503: Avatar Secret Lair Results
episode.description:
James and Cliff drop knowledge on all the lastest in #mtgfinance, including fast movers, cards to watch, meta changes and a quick look at how the Avatar Secret Lair drops played out and how the main set singles and sealed products are trending.

Intro/Outro Music by Skylarka
